features.name: Gamble Feature
features.description: Players can gamble their won feature to try winning a higher-value feature, with risk of losing and receiving a booby prize of 5x-30x bet.

features.name: Static Jackpot
features.description: Progressive jackpot system triggered by collecting 5+ Jackpot Royale symbols, featuring a win ladder and Wheel King bonus with jackpot segments.

features.name: Respin
features.context: Mini Bonus section describing Fancy Fancy's Hot Dog feature
features.description: When Hot Dog Wild lands fully on reel 5, it triggers respins where the Hot Dog Wild moves one reel left after each respin until reaching reel 1.

features.name: Wheel

features.description: Tombola-style wheel with Big Win Multiplier segments and Progressive pot segments, triggered by achieving 15+ Jackpot Royale symbols.

features.name: Symbol Transformation

features.name: Wild Reels

features.description: Brain's Water Wilds can turn entire reels wild using fire hydrants. Construction Site Free Spins features reel sets with varying amounts of wilds, with more wilds on higher levels.

features.name: Colossal Symbols
features.context: Mini Bonus section describing Hot Dog Wild and Benny's Colossal TVs
features.description: Hot Dog Wild covers 3 reel positions on reel 5. Benny's Colossal TVs feature adds colossal TV symbols to the reels that reveal mystery symbols.

specs.description: Top Cat Jackpot Royale is a 5-reel, 20-line slot based on the classic TV cartoon featuring 5 different bonus games selected through the Master Plan pick bonus. The game includes the Call or Nothing feature with random symbol transformations and a progressive Jackpot Royale system with multiple tiers.

functional_symbols.name: Wild
